part_name: ADRS Maritime Layout, compact — SCE-20H2010LP interior
description: Space-optimised interior arrangement for the ADRS maritime enclosure. Same six components as v2 (Bedrock V3000, NSP-1600, Peplink UBR Plus, Ettus B210, one OZ51x dual-TX housing, TE121024010 cooler) plus a Brainboxes ES-511 on a 290 mm TS35 DIN rail and an Advanced Navigation Certus Mini D INS on a solid pedestal. The B210 is stood on edge as a blade, which is what frees the panel width the rail needs. Placement data lives in placement.json; this file records the enclosure datums and the fabrication stock.
material: 6061-T6 aluminium plate (scaffold); enclosure, rail and modules are purchased
process: Saw, drill, tap and press brake only — no machining required for any scaffold member

vs_v2.note: Same engine, same metric, run over both placements. v2 carries 6 components in 22 items; v3 carries 8 in 29.

notes: The DIN rail is bolted flat to the subpanel, not raised on the 12 mm standoff plane: it needs the depth back, it is nowhere near the four proud corner collars, and a rail on standoffs is a spring.
Rail mounting screws must be pan or countersunk head, 3.5 mm maximum. A device clip reaches 3.5 mm into the rail channel and an M5 socket head is 5.0 mm tall.
The ES-511 has no fastener features whatsoever. The rail is its only mount, so the two screw-clamp end stops are structural, not tidiness.
